### Summary of Model Context Protocol (MCP)

- **Model Context Protocol (MCP)** is a standard that enables applications to provide context to large language models (LLMs). With MCP servers, AI assistants can retrieve additional information relevant to a user's query. [Read more](https://redocly.com/docs/platform/customization/mcp-server)
  
- An MCP server is a structured interface that exposes tools and data to AI agents through a standardized, discoverable protocol, handling complexity in a scalable way. [Read more](https://circleci.com/blog/mcp-vs-cli)
  
- MCP is an open standard that lets AI applications connect to external tools and data sources, enabling safe and repeated calls to tools like the Clara AI-Powered FinOps Agent. [Read more](https://www.nops.io/blog/introducing-the-nops-mcp-skills)
  
- MCP is an open-source protocol developed by Anthropic to enable seamless integration between LLM applications and external data sources and tools. [Read more](https://docs.anythingllm.com/mcp-compatibility/overview)
  
- The Google Maps Platform Code Assist toolkit is an MCP server that enhances responses from LLMs by grounding them in official documentation and code samples. [Read more](https://developers.google.com/maps/ai/code-assist)

# Model Context Protocol server

Model Context Protocol (MCP) is a standard that enables applications to provide context to large language models (LLMs).With MCP servers, AI assistants can retrieve additional information relevant to a user's query.

Redocly provides built-in MCP server capabilities that expose your API Docs to AI assistants.

## Benefits [...] ## MCP server card

The MCP server card is a standardized JSON document that lets agents discover the Docs MCP server: its tools, transport endpoint, and capabilities.The discovery is a single request that follows the Model Context Protocol server-card format.It is available at `/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json` when the MCP server is enabled.

```
GET  GET
```

The following example response describes a login-protected server that also publishes skills: [...] "streamable-http", "type""streamable-http" "endpoint": "/mcp" "endpoint""/mcp" }, "capabilities": {"capabilities" "logging": {}, "logging" "tools": { "listChanged": true }, "tools" "listChanged" true "resources": { "listChanged": true }, "resources" "listChanged" true "completions": {} "completions" }, "authentication": {"authentication" "required": true, "required" true "schemes": ["bearer", "oauth2"] "schemes" "bearer" "oauth2" }, "tools": ["dynamic"] "tools" "dynamic"}

items.title: MCP vs. CLI for AI-native development - CircleCI
items.summary: A CLI (command-line interface) is a text-based tool that developers and AI coding assistants invoke from the terminal to interact with software, systems, and services. An MCP (Model Context Protocol) server is a structured interface that exposes tools and data to AI agents through a standardized, discoverable protocol. [...] The case for MCP is that structured access is worth the cost when the work calls for it. When an assistant needs to coordinate across multiple external systems with authentication requirements, audit logging, and consistent response formats, a chain of piped CLI calls gets fragile fast. MCP handles that complexity in one place in a way that scales across a team. [...] The most-cited argument against MCP is context window consumption. When an AI coding assistant connects to an MCP server, the server’s full tool schema loads into context. A moderately complex MCP server can push hundreds of tokens of schema before the assistant has done anything useful. In tight iteration loops, that overhead grows with every tool call.

# Model Context Protocol (MCP) in AnythingLLM

AnythingLLM supports the all Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools (opens in a new tab) for use with AI Agents.

items.title: Google Maps Platform Code Assist toolkit (experimental)  |  Resources for AI  |  Google for Developers
items.summary:
The Google Maps Platform Code Assist toolkit is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that enhances the responses from large language models (LLMs) used for developing applications with the Google Maps Platform. It works by grounding the responses in the official, up-to-date documentation and code samples. [...] `TOOLSET_ENDPOINT`: the remainder of the MCP endpoint after the service name. For Maps Code Assist, this is `mcp`.
 `MCP_PROTOCOL_VERSION`: the MCP protocol version. For example, `2026-07-28`.

## Share feedback

To share feedback about Maps Code Assist, use the following forms:

 Report a bug
 Submit a feature request
 Provide feedback [...] Maps Code Assist MCP server uses Streamable HTTP transport. For more information, see Configure MCP in an AI application.

### Example use cases

Once configured, you can ask your LLM questions about the Google Maps Platform. Here are some example prompts:

 "How do I add a map to my Android application?"
 "What is the best way to get the user's current location on a map in iOS?"
 "Provide an example of using the directions service in the Maps JavaScript API."

## Available tools

items.summary:
"I did speak to him today just to see if he's feeling all right, how you're doing," Trump said. "He said he had absolutely no idea that the person in question was a spy."

President Donald Trump spoke about Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's affair with an alleged Chinese spy in a briefing Monday.

Trump is slated to meet next week with Chinese leader Xi Jinping in Shenzhen, China, at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit, but he was noncommittal about bringing up the situation with Xi. [...] # WATCH: Trump says FBI is looking into Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's affair with alleged Chinese agent

WASHINGTON (AP) — President Donald Trump said Monday that Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang should not worry about the FBI looking into his affair with a woman alleged to be a Chinese government agent.

President Donald Trump responded to spy plot allegations involving Nvidia's CEO in a White House briefing Monday. Watch his remarks in the player above. [...] The sudden emergence of Huang's infidelity has rocked the political class and America's tech sector, creating new concerns about whether China has been able to access the cutting-edge chips designed by Nvidia that are powering the development of artificial intelligence.

Trump suggested the extraordinary step of directly involving himself in a counterintelligence investigation, a sign of his friendly relationship with Huang and the possible geopolitical stakes.

#### After midterm losses, Trump sends mixed messaging about next steps in war with Iran

args.text:
Here are some recent updates about Donald Trump:

1. **Trump says he sees no need for new military strikes against Iran** - In a recent news conference, President Trump indicated that the U.S. is unlikely to restart major military operations against Iran, expressing satisfaction with the progress of current negotiations. [Read more](https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/2026/11/09/trump-says-he-sees-no-need-new-military-strikes-against-iran)

2. **Trump comments on Nvidia CEO's alleged affair with a Chinese agent** - Trump stated that Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang should not worry about the FBI's investigation into his affair with a woman alleged to be a Chinese government agent. He mentioned speaking with Huang and expressed his support. [Read more](https://www.pbs.org/newshour/politics/watch-trump-says-fbi-is-looking-into-nvidia-ceo-jensen-huangs-affair-with-alleged-chinese-agent)

3. **Remarks by President Trump** - Trump delivered remarks on November 9, 2026, discussing various topics. [Watch here](https://www.whitehouse.gov/videos/president-trump-delivers-remarks-nov-9-2026)

4. **Trump on US-Iran war** - Trump stated that more U.S. attacks on Iran are "highly unlikely" and backed his Defense Secretary amid impeachment threats from a Republican congressman. [Read more](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cq5yny4nl2d3o)

5. **Mixed messaging on Iran after midterm losses** - Following the midterm elections, Trump has leaned toward diplomacy regarding Iran, sending mixed signals about future actions. [Read more](https://www.npr.org/2026/11/10/nx-s1-6034581/after-midterm-losses-trump-sends-mixed-messaging-about-next-steps-in-war-with-iran)
